gate_decision.summary: Surgical fix; risk surface is the rehydrate await.

body.review_scope_summary: One-line interceptor change plus a regression test. No public interface changes.
strengths: Fix addresses the highest-ranked hypothesis without speculating beyond it.
Regression test pins the bug at the user-visible level.
concerns: If `store.rehydrated` ever rejects, the interceptor will throw on every request. Consider a timeout or .catch fallback if the store doesn't already guarantee resolution.
recommended_changes: Optional: add a unit test that the interceptor awaits rehydrated before reading the token (mock the store).
